# CI installs the pinned Node runtime; local hosts need it to execute wasm.
[!exec:node] skip 'node is required to run js/wasm binaries'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# traceOffTrim must keep trimming programs that never touch the
# tracer, and must stand down as soon as any linked code can start
# a trace. The rewrite log records that decision; executing the iterator
# programs also verifies the linked coroutine behavior after dead-code removal.
#
# Inlining is disabled for the traced programs (-gcflags=all=-l):
# otherwise the tiny StopTrace body inlines into its caller and the
# resulting direct hook call from outside the runtime disables the
# trim for an unrelated reason, hiding a control-scan regression.

env LOGOS_EXAMPLE=traceoff
cd $GOPATH/src
cd $LOGOS_EXAMPLE
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-wasm

# A traceless program is trimmed: direct hook calls are rewritten
# to the traceOff stubs.
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w -v -v' -o $WORK/plain.wasm ./plain
stderr 'traceoff: rewrite '
stderr 'traceoff: rewrite .* ref to runtime\.traceOffGoSwitch'
stderr 'traceoff: rewrite .* ref to runtime\.traceOffGoCreateSyscall'
stderr 'traceoff: rewrite runtime\.dropm ref to runtime\.traceOffLocker'

# A program that starts, drains and stops a trace directly through
# the runtime package (without importing runtime/trace) keeps every
# edge: no rewrite may happen.
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -gcflags=all=-l -ldflags='-s -w -v -v' -o $WORK/traced.wasm ./traced
! stderr 'traceoff: rewrite '

# The same holds when the control reaches the linker as a function
# value rather than a direct call.
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -gcflags=all=-l -ldflags='-s -w -v -v' -o $WORK/tracedvia.wasm ./tracedvia
! stderr 'traceoff: rewrite '

# A program that only pulls iterators keeps the trim, and the pull
# coroutine's GoSwitch call is rewritten to its stub.
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w -v -v' -o $WORK/pull.wasm ./pull
stderr 'traceoff: rewrite .* ref to runtime\.traceOffGoSwitch'
exec node --stack-size=8192 $GOROOT/lib/wasm/wasm_exec_node.js $WORK/pull.wasm
cmp stdout pull.stdout

# Same for the two-value form.
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w -v -v' -o $WORK/pull2.wasm ./pull2
stderr 'traceoff: rewrite .* ref to runtime\.traceOffGoSwitch'
exec node --stack-size=8192 $GOROOT/lib/wasm/wasm_exec_node.js $WORK/pull2.wasm
cmp stdout pull2.stdout

-- traceoff/go.mod --
module example.com/traceoff

go 1.27
-- traceoff/pull.stdout --
0
1
2
-- traceoff/pull2.stdout --

1 x
2 x
-- traceoff/plain/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func run() error {
	fmt.Println("hi")
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
-- traceoff/traced/main.lgo --
package main

import "runtime"

func main() {
	if err := runtime.StartTrace(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		buf := runtime.ReadTrace()
		if len(buf) == 0 {
			println("empty")
		}
	}
	runtime.StopTrace()
	println("traced")
}
-- traceoff/tracedvia/main.lgo --
package main

import "runtime"

func call(f func()) {
	f()
}

func main() {
	if err := runtime.StartTrace(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	call(runtime.StopTrace)
	println("traced-via-value")
}
-- traceoff/pull/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"iter"
)

func run() error {
	next, stop := iter.Pull(iter.Seq[int](func(yield func(int) bool) {
		for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
			if !yield(i) {
				return
			}
		}
	}))
	defer stop()
	for {
		v, ok := next()
		if !ok {
			break
		}
		fmt.Println(v)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
-- traceoff/pull2/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"iter"
)

func run() error {
	next, stop := iter.Pull2(iter.Seq2[int, string](func(yield func(int, string) bool) {
		for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
			if !yield(i, "x") {
				return
			}
		}
	}))
	defer stop()
	for {
		v, s, ok := next()
		if !ok {
			break
		}
		fmt.Println(v, s)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
